WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
),
stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(profit) AS mean_p, 
         SQRT(AVG(profit*profit) - AVG(profit)*AVG(profit)) AS sd_pop,
         SQRT((SUM(profit*profit) - SUM(profit)*SUM(profit)/COUNT(*))/(COUNT(*)-1)) AS sd_samp,
         MIN(profit) AS min_p, MAX(profit) AS max_p
  FROM monthly
),
mom AS (
  SELECT month, profit, LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_profit, 
         profit - LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change,
         100.0*(profit - LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month))/LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS pct_change
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT s.n, s.mean_p, s.sd_pop, s.sd_samp, 
       100.0*s.sd_pop/s.mean_p AS cv_pop_pct, 100.0*s.sd_samp/s.mean_p AS cv_samp_pct,
       s.min_p, s.max_p, s.max_p - s.min_p AS range_p, 100.0*(s.max_p-s.min_p)/s.mean_p AS range_pct_of_mean
FROM stats s

WITH pm AS (
  SELECT "Consigned Product" AS product, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY "Consigned Product", strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
),
pm_lag AS (
  SELECT product, month, profit, 
         LAG(profit) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY month) AS prev_profit
  FROM pm
)
SELECT product,
       SUM(profit - prev_profit) AS total_contribution,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-02' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_jan_feb,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-03' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_feb_mar,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-04' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_mar_apr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2023-07' THEN profit - prev_profit END) AS chg_jun_jul
FROM pm_lag WHERE prev_profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY total_contribution DESC

-- Verify: Contribution of each product to monthly profit volatility
-- By computing product-level contribution to overall monthly profit variance
WITH pm AS (
  SELECT "Consigned Product" AS product, strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, SUM(Profit) AS profit
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY "Consigned Product", strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
),
total_m AS (
  SELECT month, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM pm GROUP BY month
)
SELECT p.product, 
       ROUND(AVG(p.profit),0) AS mean_profit,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(p.profit)/(SELECT SUM(profit) FROM pm),1) AS share_pct,
       ROUND(SQRT(AVG(p.profit*p.profit)-AVG(p.profit)*AVG(p.profit))/AVG(p.profit)*100,1) AS cv_pct,
       -- Decompose variance contribution: Cov(product, total) contribution to Var(total)
       ROUND(SUM((p.profit - (SELECT AVG(p2.profit) FROM pm p2 WHERE p2.product=p.product)) * 
                  (t.total_profit - (SELECT AVG(total_profit) FROM total_m)))/11.0, 0) AS cov_with_total
FROM pm p JOIN total_m t ON p.month=t.month
GROUP BY p.product
ORDER BY share_pct DESC

         SUM(Profit) AS profit, COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM sheet1 WHERE Destination LIKE 'South China%'
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Date)
),
lag AS (
  SELECT month, profit, orders,
         LAG(profit) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS p0,
         LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS o0
  FROM m
)

       ROUND(profit-p0,0) AS total_chg,
       ROUND((orders-o0)*(p0*1.0/o0),0) AS volume_effect,
       ROUND((profit*1.0/orders - p0*1.0/o0)*orders,0) AS per_order_effect,
       ROUND(100.0*(orders-o0)/o0,2) AS orders_pct_chg,
       ROUND(100.0*(profit*1.0/orders - p0*1.0/o0)/(p0*1.0/o0),2) AS per_order_pct_chg
FROM lag WHERE p0 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY month
